items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: That's Miss Sattavid, Miss Hino, and Miss Porter, and myself.

ctx.x: To rent that saddle, I think, was about $20 just to rent that saddle and that horse. And they sold the horse. He would be still our Grand Marshal, but they sold the horse. Now, this is riding in the carriage. I'm holding my head up too high. This is Miss Brown, myself, Miss Porter, and Miss Moore. We're riding in the carriage. This is, oh, Miss Hino has seen one of these. That's Miss Sattavid, Miss Hino, and Miss Porter, and myself. Oh, now, this is the group of girls I want you to see. Ah, this is taking on my…
Yeah. I see. This is First Ball Autocrat Club, May 12, 1956.
